scope: One official public Arm document supplies candidate-format semantic comparison only. It is not original F455 CPU, memory map, loader or execution evidence.
title: Cortex-M0+ Devices Generic User Guide
locator: Section2.3.4, printed page2-18, PDF page30 (zero-based29), Figure2-1
verbatim_excerpts: The least-significant bit of each enabled vector must be 1
paraphrase: The documented vector arrangement begins with an initial stack value and reset entry. Enabled vectors use the low bit to indicate Thumb state. This generic example is suitable for a limited pattern comparison, not for assigning its M0+ target to F455.
comparison_limit: F455's architecture, exact Cortex model, STM32 or other manufacturer/part, byte order, actual vector extent, actual load address and runtime entry remain unproved. No forced-ISA disassembler or original instruction execution is used.
